name: pf-fix-puzzles-summon-hold
about: fix-puzzles-summon-hold against the built package dungeon instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). mods/puzzles: summons wait outside puzzle rooms (SummonHold.as), generically for every PlayerRecord.summons unit. A Beastmaster Ranger (fixture town-ranger, subclass ranger_beasts, Wolf Companion: a passive summon, PassiveSummonSkill spawns it within a second of the floor) on a keep floor whose puzzle room was forced: the bot parks the player in the corridor outside the doorway (the wolf leashes along), steps into the room's centre and samples the wolf for 4 s: never inside the room's world rect, `[HWP:puzzles] summons of ... held outside <room>` logged; stepping back out logs the release and the wolf rejoins within the leash. (The priest's crusaders would be the same code path, but the Priest class is DLC-gated and unavailable in the lab.)

steps.name: Wolf Companion learned (a passive summon: the wolf appears on the floor by itself)
a first run (a new profile saves no town before one)
a keep floor with a forced puzzle room (its world rect and doorway are in the log line)
the wolf held at the doorway while the owner is in the room, released after

steps.pattern: \[HWP:puzzles\] summons of \S+ held outside \S+: [1-9]\d* unit\(s\) at -?\d+,-?\d+
